swe_verified.name: SWE-bench Verified
swe_verified.what: 500 human-validated real GitHub issues (Python); % resolved. Official numbers here are the bash-only mini-SWE-agent board unless noted; leaderboard last updated 2026-02.

swe_pro.name: SWE-bench Pro (public set)
swe_pro.what: Harder, long-horizon multi-language repo tasks by Scale AI; % resolved on the public GPL subset.

swe_multilingual.name: SWE-bench Multilingual
swe_multilingual.what: 300 real GitHub issues from 41 repositories in 9 languages (C, C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Ruby, Rust); % resolved.

terminal_bench.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
terminal_bench.what: 89 hard real-world tasks solved by an agent in a terminal sandbox; % tasks passed. Agent scaffold matters (Terminus 2 is the neutral reference).

terminal_bench_4.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
terminal_bench_4.what: Current (2026) Terminal-Bench version used by frontier vendors; much harder, not comparable to 2.0. Added because 2026-H2 models report only this.

aider_polyglot.name: Aider Polyglot
aider_polyglot.what: 225 Exercism exercises in 6 languages edited via Aider; % solved within 2 attempts (pass@2). Leaderboard last updated 2025-10.

livecodebench.name: LiveCodeBench
livecodebench.what: Contamination-controlled competitive programming problems; pass@1 %. Official numbers use the v6 window 2024-08..2025-05; vendor numbers mostly 'v6' (2025-02..2025-05 or similar).

terminal_bench_2_1.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
terminal_bench_2_1.what: Revised Terminal-Bench 2 task set reported by 2026 model cards; close to 2.0 but not identical, so kept separate.
